question: Select the synonym of** Deft**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Skillful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Deft"** means someone who is skillful, adept, or quick in their movements or actions. (निपुण, कुशल)

 
 
• **Example:** The painter's deft strokes brought the artwork to life.
 
 
 
• **"Skillful"** refers to having or showing skill, especially in doing something well. (कुशल)
 
 
• **Example:** The surgeon performed the operation in a skillful manner, ensuring the patient's safety.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **"Deft"** is **"Skillful"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Skillful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inept** (अयोग्य): Lacking skill or ability to do something effectively.

 
 
• **Example:** His inept handling of the situation made things worse.
 
 
 
• **Awkward** (अटपटा): Lacking grace or ease in movement or handling.
 
 
• **Example:** The awkward silence during the meeting made everyone uncomfortable.
 
 
 
• **Clumsy** (अनाड़ी): Lacking dexterity or grace; prone to accidents or mishaps.
 
 
• **Example:** She dropped the vase due to her clumsy grip.
